fusions.name: Seeded Puncture
fusions.desc: Drives spores into the target, dealing 11 damage and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Puff of Spines
fusions.desc: Puffs out fine spines, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, each with a 20% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Buried Puffball
fusions.desc: Buries a spined puffball at the nearest enemy that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles bursts it, and it deals 16 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Bloom
fusions.desc: Every hit you land seeds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. When it reaches 5, they all burst at once, striking it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
